monster.professor_ChurchGannix_male.name: Frate
monster.professor_ChurchRevelation_femal: More a nun than a scientist, a member of Church of Revelation can provide psychological assistance. The contract under which they do not disclose information about what they do for the corporation is called a “vow of silence”.

monster.professor_combat_DaydreamChems_f: She leads humans into chemical-induced dreams, where reality is blurred and truth is a matter of a dose.

monster.psycho_UnchainedBelt_female.desc: Most pirates are rejected by ancap system because it doesn't need them. Very few are rejected because system is afraid of them. Psycho is one of those few.
monster.psycho_UnchainedBelt_female.name: Psycho
monster.psycho_UnchainedBelt_male.desc: Most pirates are rejected by ancap system because it doesn't need them. Very few are rejected because system is afraid of them. Psycho is one of those few.

monster.pyromancer_CoreWard_female.desc: HASS is for Heavily-Armed Security Specialist.
monster.pyromancer_CoreWard_female.name: HASS
monster.pyromancer_CoreWard_male.desc: HASS stands for Heavily-Armed Security Specialist. Miners who have walked kilometers through tunnels under the surface of the planets of the Solar System take putting on military gear and being sent into battle as a vacation.
monster.pyromancer_CoreWard_male.name: HASS
An embodiment of power whose only purpose is to destroy everything in their path.
monster.pyromancer_SheduThousand_male.de: An embodiment of power whose only purpose is to destroy everything in their path.
monster.quest_anc_inner_circle_female.de: One of the nine members of AnCom's Inner Charter. Behind the facade of a media conglomerate, the corporation's leadership concealed not only quasimorphosis research, but also an ancient secret order.
monster.quest_anc_inner_circle_male.desc: One of the nine members of AnCom's Inner Charter. Behind the facade of a media conglomerate, the corporation's leadership concealed not only quasimorphosis research, but also an ancient secret order.
monster.quest_anc_inner_circle_male.name: Prelate of the Charter
monster.quest_angus_male.desc: The recently appointed RealWare Security Legate, permanently fused to his power armor. No one knows anymore who controls whom—whether Dungeon controls the machine, or the machine controls Dungeon.
monster.quest_angus_male.name: Angus Dungeon
monster.quest_civ_agent_male.name: Justas
monster.quest_civ_elite_colnode_female.d: One of the leaders of the strange organization Civil Resistance, seeking to restore the former order of a long-vanished era.
monster.quest_civ_elite_colnode_male.des: One of the leaders of the strange organization Civil Resistance, seeking to restore the former order of a long-vanished era.
monster.quest_civ_elite_female.desc: One of the leaders of the strange organization Civil Resistance, seeking to restore the former order of a long-vanished era.
monster.quest_civ_elite_female.name: Colnode
monster.quest_civ_elite_male.desc: One of the leaders of the strange organization Civil Resistance, seeking to restore the former order of a long-vanished era.
monster.quest_civ_elite_male.name: Colnode
monster.quest_civ_elite_red_female.desc: One of Issachar's trusted colnodes, tasked with transporting the Red Chip, a vital component in Issachar's plan to assemble the Unity Node.
monster.quest_civ_elite_red_female.name: Issachar's Node
monster.quest_civ_elite_red_male.desc: One of Issachar's trusted colnodes, tasked with transporting the Red Chip, a vital component in Issachar's plan to assemble the Unity Node.
monster.quest_civ_elite_red_male.name: Issachar's Node
monster.quest_CivilUnity_issachar_copy_m: An energy-informational projection of a key colnode that unites a vast number of human minds. His computational power is immense, making him an extremely dangerous opponent in virtual reality.
monster.quest_CivilUnity_issachar_male.d: An energy-informational projection of a key colnode that unites a vast number of human minds. His computational power is immense, making him an extremely dangerous opponent in virtual reality.
monster.quest_dil_ceo_male.desc: The engineer who designed Geist and founded an entire field of engineering psychology that allowed humanity to survive in the far reaches of the Solar System, and even beyond it. Perceived by many as a fantasist and a dreamer, King is, in reality, a genius.
monster.quest_dil_ceo_male.name: Sergei King
monster.quest_edith_domina_female.desc: Heir to the lineage of priests of humanity's true faith. The living source of the Solar Coven's primary service. Takes no part in management, as she has devoted herself entirely to the priesthood.
monster.quest_edith_domina_female.name: Edita Domina
monster.quest_ellie_female.desc: A living SBN router. Even after all the surgical interventions on her brain, she retained the appearance of a businesswoman, which became one of SBN’s signature trademarks. In reality, nothing is known about Ally Pally’s personality beyond her media mask.
monster.quest_ellie_female.name: Ally Pally
New type footman of the Civil Resistance, batch-grown in Ei-DOS cloning vats. Pseudo-amniotic fluid still beads and drips from their grey skin, soaking their combat suits. Each clone-colnode’s phenomenal consciousness is truncated—pain, fear and fatigue are parsed as status flags, never as feelings.
monster.quest_GodBuilders_clones_male.de: New type footman of the Civil Resistance, batch-grown in Ei-DOS cloning vats. Pseudo-amniotic fluid still beads and drips from their grey skin, soaking their combat suits. Each clone-colnode’s phenomenal consciousness is truncated—pain, fear and fatigue are parsed as status flags, never as feelings.
monster.quest_GodBuilders_leah_female.de: Head of the God-Builders' Politburo. Found Prometheuths asleep on Earth and returned him to space. An extremely tough and disciplined leader, of whom only a french tunic and a pair of boots will remain after her death.
monster.quest_GodBuilders_prometheuths.d: A hylonaut quasimorph who visited Earth at humanity's dawn and breathed into it the spark of creativity and construction. Spent the last 40 000 years in hibernation until Leah carried him back into space.
monster.quest_GodBuilders_reuben_male.de: One of the founders of the Civil Resistance. Politburo member. Physicist, sociologist, and mathematician in the operations research field. He has always believed that colnodes actions must be backed by additional technical gear. Such as heavy turrets.
monster.quest_GodBuilders_simeon_male.de: One of the founders of the Civil Resistance. Politburo member. Robotics scientist that working on integrating robots into the Civil Resistance's collective networks. Simeon believes that the citizen of an ideal future state will combine the traits of both robot and human.
monster.quest_GodBuilders_zebulun_male.d: One of the founders of the Civil Resistance. Politburo member. Outstanding biologist and psychologist. Developed an education system enhanced with pharmacological support to unlock the hidden potential of the human spirit. Insisted on broad integration of clones into the Civil Resistance's collective networks.
monster.quest_john_paul_male.desc: Personally invented and theologically justified (with warranted belief) the ecumenical liturgy. Everyone may believe in their own form of faith — but only the Church of Revelation gets paid for it.
monster.quest_john_paul_male.name: John Paul VI
monster.quest_manager_female.desc: A high-level manager who has undergone expensive training on Earth. Is our goal.
monster.quest_manager_female.name: Senior manager
monster.quest_manager_male.desc: A high-level manager who has undergone expensive training on Earth. Is our goal.
monster.quest_manager_male.name: Senior manager
monster.quest_mars_baron.desc: Throughout his entire career, Ian Fraser had never known defeat. Faced with the threat of physical destruction, he decided that swearing an oath to the ancient bramfatura of Mars would be better than dying at the hands of a mercenary clone.
monster.quest_mars_baron.name: Visage of Fire
monster.quest_mars_knight.desc: An emissary of Ur, called upon to perform the assignments of the Mars bramfatura that will lead the Solar System to Gagtungr's new kingdom.
monster.quest_mars_knight.name: Anunnaku
monster.quest_merc_phantom_female.name: Matrix Projection
monster.quest_merc_phantom_male.name: Matrix Projection
monster.quest_merc_phantom.name: Matrix Projection
monster.quest_mercury_force_female.desc: Veteran and commander of military forces in the service of corporations.
monster.quest_mercury_force_female.name: Commander
monster.quest_mercury_force_male.desc: Veteran and commander of military forces in the service of corporations.
monster.quest_mercury_force_male.name: Commander
monster.quest_moon_fokerma.desc: The Great Harlot. One of the three aspects of the single being behind all events in the Solar System. Leader of Duggur, Gagtungr's bastion near Earth.
monster.quest_moon_fokerma.name: Fokerma
monster.quest_possessed_moon_female.desc: Hollow women filled with Fokerma's whispers. Strike them, and the Harlot's agony will answer in kind.
monster.quest_possessed_moon_female.name: Fokerma's Vessel
monster.quest_professor_female.desc: A pundit in the service of corporations. High scientific credentials do not in any way influence the need to eliminate it.
monster.quest_professor_female.name: Academician
monster.quest_professor_male.desc: A pundit in the service of corporations. High scientific credentials do not in any way influence the need to eliminate it.
monster.quest_professor_male.name: Academician
monster.quest_rwa_ceo_male.desc: Regent of RealWare. Rose from a janitor to the head of one of the hexarchs, personally proving that even a working social elevator can also take you to hell.
monster.quest_rwa_ceo_male.name: Ian Fraser
monster.quest_rwa_supersoldier.desc: An elite, ultra-heavy RealWare mutant. Induced hyperplasia of the right arm (the Manus Imperium project) turns the limb into a living ram: a single sweeping blow crumples shuttle doors as easily as soldiers’ ribs. RealWare mass-produces these gladiators, but each specimen is a trial even for corporation's advanced industry.
monster.quest_rwa_supersoldier.name: Murmillo
monster.quest_sbn_ceo_male.desc: CEO of the SBN corporation. One of the most influential people in the Solar System, a living router and the most effective social media executive in history. This man is ready to die for the freedom of communication, weapon in hand.
monster.quest_sbn_ceo_male.name: Roberto Millner
monster.quest_she_elite_1_male.desc: An instrument for eradicating all who stand in the way. Its arsenal and skills have surpassed the limits of human capabilities.
monster.quest_she_elite_1_male.name: Punisher
monster.quest_she_elite_2_female.desc: An instrument for eradicating all who stand in the way. Its arsenal and skills have surpassed the limits of human capabilities.
monster.quest_she_elite_2_female.name: Punisher
monster.quest_she_elite_3_male.desc: An instrument for eradicating all who stand in the way. Its arsenal and skills have surpassed the limits of human capabilities.
monster.quest_she_elite_3_male.name: Punisher
monster.quest_she_elite_4_male.desc: An instrument for eradicating all who stand in the way. Its arsenal and skills have surpassed the limits of human capabilities.
monster.quest_she_elite_4_male.name: Punisher
monster.quest_tezctlan_shattered.desc: Lord of Gannix. Once the foremost of the taltnoms—a free spirit and guardian of Gagtungr's Throne. Now the emerald Emperor of the Solar System. Tezctlan believes that, in the absence of power, he himself may become power.
monster.quest_tezctlan_shattered.name: Tezctlan
monster.quest_tezctlan.desc: Lord of Gannix. Once the foremost of the taltnoms—a free spirit and guardian of Gagtungr's Throne. Now the emerald Emperor of the Solar System. Tezctlan believes that, in the absence of power, he himself may become power.
monster.quest_tezctlan.name: Tezctlan
monster.quest_turret_emp.name: EMP-Scorcher
monster.quest_unc_commander_male.desc: Unchained Belt raider-captain who spearheads the Freedom Fleet boarding flotillas. A folk hero to outlaws, he recites the Pirate Code and is always the first through a breach, proving that freedom is worth any bloodshed.
monster.quest_unc_commander_male.name: Belt Commander
monster.quest_unc_communication_hive_mal: A pirate warlord who decided to rise up against the power that wished to save humanity in the face of Anarchy. He gathered scattered forces from across the Solar System and led them to Earth.
monster.quest_unc_communication_male.des: The man through whom the nervous system of the Unchained Belt runs. He is responsible not only for the communication between crews, but also for ensuring that the pirate crews at least sometimes act as a unified force, rather than a pack of greedy jackals.
monster.quest_unc_elite_female.desc: Not every pirate can rise to the rank of boatswain, but the best weapons and a high percentage of the share in the division of the loot are worth it.
monster.quest_unc_elite_female.name: Boatswain
monster.quest_unc_elite_male.desc: Not every pirate can rise to the rank of boatswain, but the best weapons and a high percentage of the share in the division of the loot are worth it.
monster.quest_unc_elite_male.name: Boatswain
monster.quest_unc_evil_male.desc: A new member of the Council of Commanders, who recently replaced the commander killed in the battle for Hungaria-434. People like this hold the Belt not with ideals, but with personal cruelty, reputation, and the ability to shoot first without a second thought at those who have forgotten about discipline.
monster.quest_unc_evil_male.name: Operations Commander
monster.quest_unc_sseth_hive_male.desc: The man through whom the nervous system of the Unchained Belt runs. He managed to establish such a powerful communications network and infiltrate the communications nodes of the ancap system so deeply that it was no trouble for him to organize a window in interdict mode, so that the united forces could capture the AnCom bunker on the Orkney Islands.
monster.quest_unc_sseth_hive_male.name: Belt Admiral
monster.quest_unc_sseth_male.desc: A pirate warlord who managed to turn scattered crews into something resembling a fleet. Under his command, anarchy has long ceased to be a dream, and has become an effective way to hold power over those who have nowhere else to go.
monster.quest_unc_sseth_male.name: Belt Admiral
monster.quest_venus_baron.desc: When the time comes to gather the harvest, Tezctlan calls the Tlamacazqui. The High Priest of Gannix can slay a quasimorph without losing even a drop of gavvakh. Now that Gannix has pierced the human world, Tlamacazqui can store not just pitiful crumbs, but fill bottomless vessels with human energy.
monster.quest_venus_baron.name: Gannix Tlamacazqui
monster.quest_venus_boss_ziggurat.desc: The immovable warden of the Emerald Empire's gavvakh reserves. Nanauatzin is the embodiment of firmness, phase-shifted as a result of a prolonged ritual conducted shortly after Tezctlan's awakening.
monster.quest_venus_boss_ziggurat.name: Nanauatzin
monster.quest_venus_bossfight.desc: Great and Accepted Knight of Gannix. Poisonous warrior of Tezctlan. No one knows why he is called "the poisonous one." However, Gannix has its own rules. What is poisonous in the army of Tezctlan might just be toxic in the physical reality.
monster.quest_venus_bossfight.name: Ilhutl
monster.quest_venus_demon_warrior.desc: A monster from the depths of the Bramfatura of Venus. One of the loyal warlords of Tezctlan.
monster.quest_venus_demon_warrior.name: Duke of Gannix
monster.quest_venus_guardian.desc: Warrior of the Order of the Feathered Masks. Personally loyal to Xiomara. Infected with her fanatical hatred for Tezctlan, who once left Gannix to its fate.
monster.quest_venus_guardian.name: Xiomara's Tlaloc
monster.quest_venus_guffaws.desc: The embodied ritual laughter of Tezctlan. He sanctifies the Emerald Emperor's power by turning the humiliation of others into the realization of cosmic law.
monster.quest_venus_guffaws.name: Warden of the Guffaw
monster.quest_venus_herald.desc: A messenger of Tezctlan who has gathered enough gavvakh within his incarnate form to be of use to Tezctlan.
monster.quest_venus_herald.name: Paynal of Tezctlan
monster.quest_venus_screams.desc: The embodied scream into which any sufficiently prolonged laughter turns. This duke's voice carries over the sacrificial steps, where power over life becomes absolute.
monster.quest_venus_screams.name: Warden of the Scream
monster.quest_venus_snickers.desc: The embodied quiet snicker of Gannix's courtiers. This duke teaches the Empire the art of justifying cruelty.
monster.quest_venus_snickers.name: Warden of the Snicker
monster.quest_venus_topil.desc: The Nakal of Tezctlan, unified in eleven bodies. Indestructible until a fully voluntary sacrifice of gavvakh is offered in his presence.
monster.quest_venus_topil.name: Topilzin
monster.quest_worker_captive_female.desc: Workers are the backbone of corporate wealth. This poor soul was on one of the stations seized by Tezctlan's servants.
monster.quest_worker_captive_female.name: Tonatiuh's Captive
monster.quest_worker_captive_male.desc: Workers are the backbone of corporate wealth. This poor soul was on one of the stations seized by Tezctlan's servants.
monster.quest_worker_captive_male.name: Tonatiuh's Captive
monster.quest_worker_female.desc: Workers are the backbone of corporate wealth. This poor soul was on one of the stations seized by Tezctlan's servants.
monster.quest_worker_female.name: Freed Worker
monster.quest_worker_male.desc: Workers are the backbone of corporate wealth. This poor soul was on one of the stations seized by Tezctlan's servants.
monster.quest_worker_male.name: Freed Worker
monster.recruit_RealWare_female.name: Recruit
monster.recruit_RealWare_male.name: Recruit
monster.ron_baron.desc: Barounazes of Ron are gatherers of the shards of metamatters breaking off from other bramfaturas when they are shaken by catastrophes.
monster.ron_baron.name: Barounaz
monster.ron_knight.desc: The knights of Ron are clots of metamatter of hatred. Hatred has polished their form, and now aknaraks can and wish only to kill.
monster.ron_knight.name: Aknarak
monster.ron_pact_baron.desc: Barounazes of Ron are gatherers of the shards of metamatters breaking off from other bramfaturas when they are shaken by catastrophes.
monster.ron_pact_baron.name: Barounaz
monster.ron_shade.desc: One of the quasimorphic races of antihumanity, shaped in the dark depths of Ron through countless incarnations within layers of quasimorphic materiality.
monster.ron_shade.name: Rarugg
monster.ron_slave.desc: Small and swift servants of Ron execute all commands of cruel aknaraks and barounazes. They also keep the knowledge of the bramfatura.
monster.ron_slave.name: Amuggas
monster.rwa_elite_female.desc: Realware organizes its internal security forces on the basis of small task forces with access to absolutely any known weapon.
monster.rwa_elite_female.name: Tercio Soldado
monster.rwa_elite_male.desc: Realware organizes its internal security forces on the basis of small task forces with access to absolutely any known weapon.
monster.rwa_elite_male.name: Brigadier Tercia
monster.sbn_elite_female.desc: SBN Rapid Response Combat Teams reporting directly to the highest levels of corporate management
monster.sbn_elite_female.name: SBN Secret Service
monster.sbn_elite_male.desc: SBN Rapid Response Combat Teams reporting directly to the highest levels of corporate management.
monster.sbn_elite_male.name: SBN Secret Service
monster.scientist_CoreWard_female.desc: Lives for the exogeology, studying alien life forms and ancient structures found in mines - even if it costs the lives of miners.
monster.scientist_CoreWard_female.name: Geologist
monster.scientist_CoreWard_male.desc: Lives for the exogeology, studying alien life forms and ancient structures found in mines - even if it costs the lives of miners.
monster.scientist_CoreWard_male.name: Geologist
monster.scientist_DaydreamChems_female.d: This scientist clearly works with toxic substances and is probably armed with some kind of dangerous scientific equipment.
monster.scientist_DaydreamChems_male.des: This scientist clearly works with toxic substances and is probably armed with some kind of dangerous scientific equipment.
monster.scientist_female.desc: Scientists have dedicated their lives to science. Their parents had enough resources and influence that they could afford to teach their children for several years. Such investments pay off well, as corporations value such scientists in their research departments.
monster.scientist_female.name: Scientist
monster.scientist_Grasshopper_female.des: A Grasshopper Tek scientist who patches up crew members and spacecrafts on the move, often under fire.
monster.scientist_Grasshopper_male.desc: A Grasshopper Tek scientist who patches up crew members and spacecrafts on the move, often under fire.
monster.scientist_Grasshopper_male.name: Rustman
monster.scientist_male.desc: Scientists have dedicated their lives to science. Their parents had enough resources and influence that they could afford to teach their children for several years. Such investments pay off well, as corporations value such scientists in their research departments.
monster.scientist_male.name: Scientist
monster.scientist_PlanetBridge_female.de: An architect of the impossible, whose calculations and formulas subject the cosmic void to logic and mathematics.
monster.scientist_PlanetBridge_male.desc: An architect of the impossible, whose calculations and formulas subject the cosmic void to logic and mathematics.
monster.scientist_PlanetBridge_male.name: Metastruktor
monster.scrivnus_baron.desc: The baron of Skrivnus, one of the rulers of the Great Prison where captives endlessly wrestle against their own consciousness.
monster.scrivnus_baron.name: Karzur
monster.scrivnus_knight.desc: The knight of Skrivnus — jailer and personal tormentor. Tarkaores do not fight to protect their bramfatura’s essence. They battle for the right to guard the eternal prison.
monster.scrivnus_knight.name: Tarkaor
monster.scrivnus_pact_baron.desc: The baron of Skrivnus, one of the rulers of the Great Prison where captives endlessly wrestle against their own consciousness.
monster.scrivnus_pact_baron.name: Karzur
monster.scrivnus_servitor.desc: The keeper of the prison walls of Skrivnus. His essence is so deeply intertwined with the essence of the prison that he literally cannot comprehend what freedom means.
monster.scrivnus_servitor.name: Gremmugrat
monster.scrivnus_terror.desc: A paladin of Skrivnus: chief over the jailers and steward of executions. Karossas are those knights who have earned the right to guard the eternal prison.
monster.scrivnus_terror.name: Karossa
monster.security_Dilthey_female.desc: Their job is to control and adjust the actions of combat forces. They have the necessary combat skills to not only observe the battlefield, but also to intervene at key moments.
monster.security_Dilthey_female.name: Inspector
monster.security_Dilthey_male.desc: Their job is to control and adjust the actions of combat forces. They have the necessary combat skills to not only observe the battlefield, but also to intervene at key moments.
monster.security_Dilthey_male.name: Inspector
monster.security_Emeraldlight_female.des: Emerald Coven staffs their Security Service with employees, on whom they can spend the least dignitas. These are soldiers fired from previous jobs, deserters, former pirates, and so on.
monster.security_Emeraldlight_male.desc: Emerald Coven staffs their Security Service with employees, on whom they can spend the least dignitas. These are soldiers fired from previous jobs, deserters, former pirates, and so on.
monster.security_Emeraldlight_male.name: Guardian
monster.security_female.desc: Security Service specialists are the watchdogs of their corporations. They're willing to go to great lengths to not have to hunch over assembly lines or descend deep into the ground in mining stations.
monster.security_female.name: Security Specialist
monster.security_male.desc: Security Service specialists are the watchdogs of their corporations. They're willing to go to great lengths to not have to hunch over assembly lines or descend deep into the ground in mining stations.

monster.security_Sunlight_male.name: Guardian
monster.security_Tianming_female.desc: Low-grade clone bred for vigilance, not valor. She can salute, report, and die in sequence.
monster.security_Tianming_female.name: Sentinel
monster.security_Tianming_male.desc: Low-grade clone bred for vigilance, not valor. He can salute, report, and die in sequence.
monster.security_Tianming_male.name: Sentinel
monster.she_elite_female.desc: An instrument for eradicating all who stand in the way. Their arsenal and skills exceeded human capabilities.
monster.she_elite_female.name: Punisher
monster.she_elite_male.desc: An instrument for eradicating all who stand in the way. Their arsenal and skills exceeded human capabilities.
monster.she_elite_male.name: Punisher
monster.she_enforcer_SheduThousand_femal: The main combat unit. A living destruction machine.
The main combat unit. A living destruction machine.
monster.she_security_SheduThousand_femal: The shadow of Shedu, gliding in the darkness. Gathers information and sows panic among enemies.
The shadow of Shedu, gliding in the darkness. Gathers information and sows panic among enemies.
Shipbound gunnery arrays need expert guidence to work at their fullest.
monster.siegemaster_PlanetBridge_male.de: Shipbound gunnery arrays need expert guidence to work at their fullest.
monster.sniper_AnCom_female.desc: AnCom prides itself on precision of their interventions, yet sometimes it's still not enough. Augurs are final solution to this problem.
monster.sniper_AnCom_female.name: Augur
